why: GNU license files, Emacs Lisp and Python put a form feed alone on its line as a page break (GNU Coding Standards 5.1, PEP 8), and xterm treats FF like LF: it hides no text. Measured, 90 of 101 form feeds in the licenses and libraries of Git for Windows and Python 3.12 sit alone on their line. The pass side is a COPYING with one on its own LF line and a docs/LICENSE.txt with one on its own CRLF line. The fail side is a README.md with a form feed in the middle of a line. Without the exemption the pass side goes red; exempting every form feed in prose turns the fail side green.
